hook.name: YoyoStrategyHook
hook.description: A fee-taking hook that charges a time-decaying fee (starting at 26%, decreasing 200 bps every 25 blocks) on all swaps, taken from the output token via afterSwapReturnsDelta. When the fee currency is WETH, a 100% fee is applied instead. Non-ETH fees are converted to ETH via a nested pool swap and forwarded to a designated fee address.
